lastText: The Night EndsThe Sovereign of FogNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15THE WOLVES OF LONDON: A POLICE INQUIRYThe fog thickens until you can touch it, and every dog, rat and wolf in the south of England is in the streets that night. It is a remarkable thing to have a pack hunt for you: you have never needed it so little. The Thames freezes at its edges. In the morning there is only a fog and a feeling of having been looked at. It goes on for nine days. At the end of them, a great deal of London has left, and the rest keeps its lamps lit. The tellings differ, but they agree on one thing: that whatever he did, he did it in a great hurry, as if he were afraid there would not be enough time. People remember that he wept. A girl from the village says that she saw him, on the night of the storm, standing on the cliff with his hands over his face.
